subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should successful embedded `after_compaction` hooks gain a public, current-session-scoped deferred `resetSession(reason?)` capability?
rationale: This is a new compatibility-sensitive plugin contract with authority to archive and rotate session state; source review can establish safe mechanics, but only the hook-surface owner can approve its permanent scope.

options.title: Approve narrow compaction API
options.body: Expose the method only to successful embedded `after_compaction` hooks and require run-owned deferred flushing, focused compatibility tests, docs, and positive live proof.

options.title: Keep reset internal
options.body: Reject the public hook method and keep session rotation owned by core compaction or context-engine lifecycle code.

options.title: Design a general lifecycle API
options.body: Pause this PR and define a broader permissioned plugin session-lifecycle contract separately rather than adding a compaction-specific method now.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow compaction API
recommendation.body: Expose the method only to successful embedded `after_compaction` hooks and require run-owned deferred flushing, focused compatibility tests, docs, and positive live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current compaction hook contract and are the strongest history-backed owner for deciding whether this new method belongs on it.
